name: Windows Workspace Validation Probe
description: SDK probe for manual and opt-in automatic exact-host Workspace validation: current/status, bounded workspace matrix operations, and fail-closed behavior through the real PluginContext.workspace() path.

permissions.reason: Read the current workspace identity and the live available workspace list during manual exact-host validation.
Read the bounded readiness snapshot (active document and model identity) during manual exact-host validation.
Invoke the verified workspace switch, update-default, and reset-default host commands during manual exact-host validation.
